simple: A digital “bunker” for your most important data: automatically copies it to an isolated vault — in your own data center or in the cloud — with a physical or logical “air gap”, a separate network, and its own accounts, MFA and management that never connect to production systems. Copies are immutable at the PowerProtect hardware level, with protection against clock tampering (NTP). Cyber Detect (CyberSense) analytics inspects the full contents of files, databases and virtual machines, spots encryption, mass deletion and other signs of ransomware damage, and after an attack provides a report: what is damaged, whose files, and which is the last clean copy — so you can recover without reinfection. Works with open systems and mainframes; has automated recovery playbooks for critical systems.
